# Temple Scroll Column 62 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 62 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**62:1** If there is found among you, in one of your cities that I am giving you, a man or a woman who does what is evil in my sight,

**62:2** by going to serve other gods and bowing down to them — to the sun or the moon or any of the host of heaven,

**62:3** which I have not commanded — and it is reported to you and you hear of it,

**62:4** then you shall investigate thoroughly. If indeed the matter is true and established — such an abomination has been committed in Israel —

**62:5** you shall bring that man or that woman who has committed this evil deed to your gates, and you shall stone them with stones until they die.

**62:6** By the testimony of two witnesses or three witnesses shall the condemned be put to death; no one shall be put to death by the testimony of a single witness.

**62:7** The hand of the witnesses shall be first against him to execute him, and the hand of all the people thereafter. So you shall purge the evil from your midst.

**62:8** If any case is too difficult for you to adjudicate — whether it concerns bloodshed, legal claims, or bodily injury — any matter of dispute within your gates —

**62:9** you shall arise and go up to the place that I shall choose, and come before the Levitical priests and the judge who holds office in those days.

**62:10** You shall inquire of them, and they shall declare to you the verdict.

**62:11** You shall act in accordance with the verdict they declare to you from that place which I shall choose, and you shall take care to do all that they instruct you.

**62:12** According to the instruction they give you and the judgment they pronounce, you shall act. You shall not deviate from the word they declare to you, either to the right or to the left.

**62:13** The man who acts presumptuously by refusing to heed the priest who stands ministering there before me, or the judge — that man shall die. So you shall purge the evil from Israel.

**62:14** All the people shall hear of it and be afraid, and shall not act presumptuously again.

**62:15** If you hear it said concerning one of your cities that I am giving you to dwell in:

**62:16** Worthless men, sons of Belial, have gone out from your midst and have led astray the inhabitants of their city, saying: Let us go and serve other gods whom you have not known —

---

*SOPHIA notes: Council adopted LOGOS as baseline with EMET's "sons of Belial" added alongside LOGOS's "worthless men" in 62:16, since this is a key Qumran theological term. "Verdict" (LOGOS) preferred over "word of judgment" (EMET) for clarity. PNEUMA's "arrogantly" replaced with "presumptuously" (EMET/LOGOS) to maintain biblical legal register. First-person divine speech preserved throughout.*
